get.description: Time zone and capabilities of the plant.

Curves of the requested fields, raw or condensed to about `points` rows.

With `format=csv` the same view as a CSV file without the rows of nulls at gaps; `check=true`
only checks and answers 204. `raw=true` (every record, Minutenwerte, any number of fields, all
of them without `fields`) needs `format=csv`.

Key figures per day, week or month and their sum over the range.

With `format=csv` the periods as a CSV file; `check=true` only checks and answers 204.

Key figures of every field of the stock over the range, one computation per plant at a time.

All plants of the process share `[field_stats] parallel` computations; a request may wait for those of
other plants.

With `format=csv` one row per field as a CSV file; `check=true` only checks (range, `when`, the
writer) without computing and answers 204.

Compressor runs and defrosts that begin in the range.

With `format=csv` the runs as a CSV file; `check=true` only checks and answers 204.
Shipped views first, then own ones by name.

post.description: Save a new view under a new id.

put.description: Change parts of an own view; `start` also works on shipped views.

Store the raw body under `upload/`; 200 instead of 201 if the content was known already.

Without the capability the dependency answers 403 before this runs: the body is not read.

post.description:
Start a run, or queue one behind the running one; answers with the status.

`upload`: the page just sent files. `fetch`: fetch from the control first; 409 if that has no address.
403 if the plant lacks the capability of the trigger (checked first).

get.description: Runner state and the last logged run; during a write window the run last read.

One page of the import log; `counts` and `sources` cover the whole log.

With `format=csv` every hit of the filter as a CSV file (`offset` and `limit` do not apply),
times in the zone of the plant; `check=true` only checks and answers 204.

The newest runs first.

With `format=csv` every run of the log as a CSV file (`limit` does not apply), times in the
zone of the plant; `check=true` only checks and answers 204.
Address and switch of the fetch; `error` is set while settings.json cannot be used.

put.description: Store the settings; the runner plans again at once. 403 without the capability `fetch`.

AnalogFigures.title: AnalogFigures
AnalogFigures.description: `mean`, `median` and `sd` are null and `histogram` is empty for a field without time with weight.

BitFigures.title: BitFigures
BitFigures.description: `share_on` is null without time with weight; `on` and `off` are null without a complete phase.

CapabilitiesInfo.title: CapabilitiesInfo
CapabilitiesInfo.description: What this plant may do; `import` is a Python keyword, so the field has an alias.

CurrentRunInfo.title: CurrentRunInfo
CurrentRunInfo.description: The run in progress; times are UTC without zone like the import log.

texts.title: Texts
texts.description: Anzeigetexte, die in dieser Kurve vorkommen; nur bei Zuständen

text.title: Text
text.description: Je Zeile der Index in `texts`, null ohne Text; nur bei Zuständen

sections.description: Abschnitte des Zustands, null bei Messwerten und Bits und über 2 × points Abschnitten

Curve.title: Curve
Curve.description:
Values of one field, as long as `ts`; `min` and `max` only for condensed measured values,
`texts`, `text` and `sections` only for state fields.

EnumShare.title: EnumShare
EnumShare.description:
Time share of a display text, or of one code without text.

`codes` are the codes of the text in the order of their first appearance in the range; `text`
is null without a text, then `codes` has exactly one entry.

FetchInfo.title: FetchInfo
FetchInfo.description:
The fetch from the control; times are UTC without zone like the import log.

`last_saved_name` is the file that run saved. `last_error` and `last_error_at` are the last
failed fetch if it is newer than any save or duplicate. `settings_error` names an unusable
settings.json, the fetch rests meanwhile. `next_run` is null while the fetch is off,
locked, without address or running.

FetchSettingsAnswer.title: FetchSettingsAnswer
FetchSettingsAnswer.description: `allowed` is `[fetch] enabled` of dtaluchs.toml; `error` names an unusable settings.json.

FetchSettingsBody.title: FetchSettingsBody
FetchSettingsBody.description: Both fields are required; the address is checked in the router.

FieldInfo.title: FieldInfo

FieldScopeResponse.title: FieldScopeResponse
FieldScopeResponse.description: What a range holds before any figure is computed: records that count and the bits with a value.

Fixed.title: Fixed
Fixed.description: A fixed range in controller time, seconds; serialised as `from` and `to`.

Gaps.title: Gaps
Gaps.description: Gaps between records of the range, without `when`.

ImportFiles.title: ImportFiles
ImportFiles.description: `total` counts the hits of the filter, `counts` and `sources` the whole log.

ImportStatus.title: ImportStatus
ImportStatus.description: `error` is the text of the last child that ended badly, also where no run was logged.

Item.title: Item
Item.description: A field in a chart or in the signal area with its colour slot.

KindColumns.title: KindColumns
KindColumns.description: Block "Läufe nach Art": complete runs by kind, only kinds that have one.

KindFigures.title: KindFigures
KindFigures.description: Figures of one temperature per kind: one entry per kind, null without a value.

LastRunInfo.title: LastRunInfo
LastRunInfo.description: The newest run in the import log with the files it read, not the unchanged ones.

MetaResponse.title: MetaResponse
MetaResponse.description: What the frontend needs to know about this installation and its stock.

Phases.title: Phases
Phases.description: Seconds of the complete phases of a bit.

Preset.title: Preset
Preset.description: A range relative to the last record of the stock: quick choice or calendar period.

RunColumns.title: RunColumns
RunColumns.description: Compressor runs in order of their start, one column per property.

text.title: Text
text.description: Je Abschnitt der Index in `texts` der Kurve, null ohne Text

Sections.title: Sections
Sections.description: The runs of a state, equally long arrays ordered by `start`.

SourceInfo.title: SourceInfo
SourceInfo.description: `path` is null without a source; `next_run` is null while a run is going or without a beat.

StatsResponse.title: StatsResponse
StatsResponse.description: One column per figure, as long as `start`.

StatsTotal.title: StatsTotal
StatsTotal.description: The whole range, by the same rules as one period.

UnchangedField.title: UnchangedField
UnchangedField.description:
A field whose value did not change in the range; `value` is the raw code for a state.

`text` is the display text of that state, null for any other kind and for a state without text.
`codes` are the codes of that state in the order of their first appearance (several when one
text covers more codes), empty for any other kind.

UploadAnswer.title: UploadAnswer
UploadAnswer.description: `name` is the stored name, for a duplicate the name already stored or logged.

ViewPatch.title: ViewPatch
ViewPatch.description: Any parts of a view; fields left out stay as they are.

ViewsResponse.title: ViewsResponse
ViewsResponse.description:
Shipped views first, then own ones by name; `problem` names what views.json got wrong.

`writable` is false only when views.json cannot be read, then every write answers 503.
